fitReason: Strong embodied robot-learning match: neural policy learning and sim-to-real transfer are integrated with state estimation and geometry-aware terrain interaction. physicalEvidence.summary: The full June 2026 pedipulation paper verifies PPO-trained navigation and leg-manipulation policies on an actual Unitree Go2 outdoors. Fourteen concrete-slope/faux-rock trials include twelve successful contacts under the paper’s force-threshold definition. Navigation uses the robot’s built-in locomotion controller; their separately trained locomotion policy is simulation-only. Manipulation emits twelve joint targets. This is current ERAU-affiliated execution, corroborated by the official local SRGE hardware laboratory.

unknowns: Official university faculty and lab pages verify current Daytona Beach Aerospace appointment and public email. The lab was established in 2025; do not mistake a new lab for a guaranteed new-faculty summer opening.

Hardware inference runs on an external Ethernet-connected computer. Human buttons confirm mode changes, arming, pushing and safety stops, although steering and task trajectories are not manually supplied. Avoid claiming onboard or completely human-free execution.

The object-perception stage uses geometric LiDAR clustering/normals and a four-waypoint spline; it is not an end-to-end VLA. Only one target object is tested. The larger225/150-trial comparisons are simulation, not additional physical trials; terrestrial tests do not demonstrate space operation.
